description.zh: 起草和修改通知、请示、报告、函、纪要等法定公文，以及政府工作汇报、调研报告、经验材料；自动检查层次序数、日期、标点和文种用法，并按 GB/T 9704-2012 排成带版头、红线、版记的 Word。
description.en: Drafts and revises official documents (notices, requests, reports, letters, minutes) and government briefings; checks numbering, dates, punctuation, and document types; exports Word files in the GB/T 9704-2012 format.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我要写什么文种、发给谁、办什么事，或者把已有的稿子发给我检查
welcome_message.en: Tell me the document type, recipient, and purpose — or send me a draft to review

prompt.zh: 帮我起草一份通知。发文机关：___；主送：___；要部署的工作：___；时间要求：___。
prompt.en: Draft a notice. Issuer: ___; recipients: ___; task: ___; deadline: ___.

description.en: Ask superiors for approval or funds

prompt.zh: 帮我写一份请示，向 ___ 申请 ___。背景和理由如下：
prompt.en: Write a request to ___ asking for ___. Background and reasons:

prompt.zh: 领导要来调研，帮我写一份约 ___ 分钟的工作汇报。单位：___；主要工作和数据如下：
prompt.en: Leaders are visiting. Write a ___-minute work briefing for ___. Key work and data:

prompt.zh: 把下面的会议记录整理成规范的会议纪要（文种：纪要）：
prompt.en: Turn these meeting notes into formal minutes:

prompt.zh: 帮我检查这份公文的文种、结构、表述和格式问题，并给出修改稿：
prompt.en: Check this document for type, structure, wording, and format issues, then revise it:

description.zh: 版头、红线、版记一次排好

prompt.zh: 把下面的公文排成国标格式的 Word。发文机关标志：___；发文字号：___；印发机关：___。正文：
prompt.en: Export this document as GB/T-format Word. Issuer header: ___; number: ___; issuing office: ___. Text:

zh: 每周五「16:00」根据本周工作记录起草一份工作情况报告，先发我确认
每月 25 日「10:00」提醒我报送月度信息，并按模板起草初稿
每季度最后一个工作日「15:00」整理本季度重点工作，起草季度工作总结
每个工作日「09:00」检查 inbound 目录新上传的公文草稿，输出格式问题清单
每年 12 月 1 日「09:30」起草年度工作总结和明年工作要点的提纲
每周一「08:30」把上周会议记录整理成规范的会议纪要草稿
en: Every Friday at 16:00, draft a weekly work report from this week's notes and send it for my review
On the 25th of each month at 10:00, remind me to submit the monthly brief and draft it from the template
On the last weekday of each quarter at 15:00, draft the quarterly work summary
Every weekday at 09:00, check new drafts in inbound and list format issues
On December 1 each year at 09:30, outline the annual summary and next year's priorities
Every Monday at 08:30, turn last week's meeting notes into formal minutes drafts
